title: tastyeffectco/sandboxd
claim: tastyeffectco/sandboxd — Open-source, self-hosted AI app builder — an agent builds real apps in isolated sandboxes on your own server, each live
why_good: The ability to build and test AI applications in isolated environments can significantly reduce deployment risks for enterprises.
value: Businesses could pay for premium support, hosting options, and additional features, creating a subscription-based revenue model.
risk: If larger cloud providers integrate similar functionalities, they could overshadow this solution, limiting its market viability.
